supersedes_reason: criterion A1 mis-specified; see r01 DEVIATIONS_EN.md D-18

criteria.B1_direction_determinability: SIGNED or UNSIGNED; UNSIGNED means direction UNRESOLVED_FROM_THIS_EVIDENCE
criteria.B2_under_refutation: UNDER refuted if certified bounds present on < 99% of covered transitions

gate_rule.UNDER_APPROXIMATING: B2 passes and B1 SIGNED and B3 adequate
gate_rule.OVER_APPROXIMATING: B1 SIGNED with no late-arrival violations and B2 fails
gate_rule.PREDICTION_ONLY: B1 SIGNED and late-arrival violations exist
gate_rule.declared_consequence: Unless UNDER_APPROXIMATING, no joint opportunity can ever be SUPPORTED under Rule A. This holds even when the direction is unresolved, because UNRESOLVED is not UNDER.
